entries.title: James 4:1
segments: Whence [come] wars and whence [come] fightings among you? [come they] not hence, [even] of your pleasures that war in your members?

entries.title: James 4:2
segments: Ye lust, and have not: ye kill, and covet, and cannot obtain: ye fight and war; ye have not, because ye ask not.

entries.title: James 4:3
segments: Ye ask, and receive not, because ye ask amiss, that ye may spend [it] in your pleasures.

entries.title: James 4:4
segments: Ye adulteresses, know ye not that the friendship of the world is enmity with God? Whosoever therefore would be a friend of the world maketh himself an enemy of God.

entries.title: James 4:5
segments: Or think ye that the scripture speaketh in vain? Doth the spirit which he made to dwell in us long unto envying?

entries.title: James 4:6
segments: But he giveth more grace. Wherefore [the scripture] saith, God resisteth the proud, but giveth grace to the humble.

entries.title: James 4:7
segments: Be subject therefore unto God; but resist the devil, and he will flee from you.

entries.title: James 4:8
segments: Draw nigh to God, and he will draw nigh to you. Cleanse your hands, ye sinners; and purify your hearts, ye doubleminded.

entries.title: James 4:9
segments: Be afflicted, and mourn, and weep: let your laughter be turned to mourning, and your joy to heaviness.

entries.title: James 4:10
segments: Humble yourselves in the sight of the Lord, and he shall exalt you.

entries.title: James 4:11
segments: Speak not one against another, brethren. He that speaketh against a brother, or judgeth his brother, speaketh against the law, and judgeth the law: but if thou judgest the law, thou art not a doer of the law, but a judge.

entries.title: James 4:12
segments: One [only] is the lawgiver and judge, [even] he who is able to save and to destroy: but who art thou that judgest thy neighbor?

entries.title: James 4:13
segments: Come now, ye that say, To-day or to-morrow we will go into this city, and spend a year there, and trade, and get gain:

entries.title: James 4:14
segments: whereas ye know not what shall be on the morrow. What is your life? For ye are a vapor, that appeareth for a little time, and then vanisheth away.

entries.title: James 4:15
segments: For that ye ought to say, If the Lord will, we shall both live, and do this or that.

entries.title: James 4:16
segments: But now ye glory in your vauntings: all such glorying is evil.

entries.title: James 4:17
segments: To him therefore that knoweth to do good, and doeth it not, to him it is sin.
